name: qa-explore
description: A team of AI agents that test your web app like a human QA team, then codify what they find into a self-growing Playwright/Cypress suite. Runs headless in CI via the Claude Agent SDK, or as a Claude Code plugin.
author: Víctor
//: Published from the REPO ROOT, not from runner/. The CLI resolves its engines at ../../skills relative to runner/bin, which is repo/skills in a checkout and <pkg>/skills once installed — the same expression either way. Publishing runner/ on its own shipped 9 files and no engines, so every skill died with ENOENT on node_modules/skills.
